checks.name: Default playback starts without pointer or focus prerequisites

Explicit pause survives navigation controls
Explicit play restarts the clock
Hidden documents stop timers without discarding manual state
Reduced-motion preference prevents automatic playback
Repeated start replaces rather than duplicates timers
Disposal clears timers and prevents further controls
Adjacent appointments share a lane; overlapping ones do not
Chained overlaps retain enough independent lanes
Cancelled and no-show appointments do not occupy the time grid
Unassigned chairs are visible rather than silently dropped
Timeline expands beyond normal hours without clipping appointments
Cross-midnight intervals clip at the selected local day
Keyword, dentist and status filters combine
Date navigation is stable at month/year/leap boundaries
Only active date-effective assignments create empty doctor columns
Retired resources with actual appointments remain traceable
Input records are not mutated by layout or filtering
Timeline text and attributes are escaped
